name: Gas Release Pose
intro:
Gas Release Pose (Pawanmuktasana) is a highly effective yoga posture designed to improve digestion and relieve gas, bloating, and constipation. In this pose, the knees are gently drawn towards the chest, applying pressure on the abdominal region, which stimulates the digestive organs and helps in releasing trapped gas from the intestines.

This posture is simple yet powerful and is often included in beginner yoga routines due to its immediate benefits. The gentle compression of the abdomen enhances blood circulation to the digestive organs, improving their efficiency and promoting better metabolism. It also helps in strengthening the lower back and abdominal muscles.

Regular practice of Pawanmuktasana not only supports digestive health but also helps reduce lower back stiffness and tension. It is especially beneficial for people with sedentary lifestyles or those who experience frequent digestive discomfort. Combined with deep breathing, this pose promotes relaxation, reduces stress, and contributes to overall physical and mental well-being.

steps.text: Lie flat on your back with your legs extended and arms beside your body.
Inhale deeply and bend your knees towards your chest.
Wrap your arms around your knees and hold them tightly.
Exhale and gently lift your head, bringing your chin towards your knees.
Hold the position while breathing slowly and comfortably.
Release and return to the starting position slowly.

benefits: Massages internal organs and improves blood circulation
Reduces lower back pain and stiffness
Helps in relieving acidity and indigestion
Improves flexibility in hips and thighs
Supports detoxification of the digestive system
avoid: You have severe back pain or spinal injuries
You have hernia or recent abdominal surgery
You suffer from severe neck pain
You have high blood pressure (consult a doctor before practice)
You feel discomfort or pain while holding the pose
You have severe hip or knee injuries
